description.text: Computer science and technology is a discipline that studies the design, development, application and theory of computer systems. It integrates knowledge from multiple fields such as mathematics, engineering and logic, aiming to solve core problems such as information processing, algorithm design and system construction. This major covers both theoretical foundations and practical applications, and is one of the core disciplines promoting the information technology revolution.

duration.text: The Computer science and technology at Shenyang Agricultural University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. One original copy and one photocopy of Application Form of Liaoning Provincial Government Scholarship for International Students (see the attachment)2. Notarized certificate of highest degree and transcripts. A certificate of enrollment or a certificate of employment should also be submitted if applicants have been officially employed for a job. Documents that are formulated neither in Chinese of English should be enclosed with a notarized Chinese or English version upon submission.3. One original copy and photocopy of Foreigners Physical Examination Report4. Study and Research Plan in China (no less than 1000 words)5. Recommendation letters from 2 professors or associate professors of the previous school.
